text: Name OsSpinlockSuccessor [ECUC_Os_01022] Parent Container OsSpinlock Description Reference to OsApplications that have an access to this object. | To check whether a spinlock can be occupied (in a nested way) without any danger of deadlock, a linked list of spinlocks can be defined. A spinlock can only be occupied in the order of the linked list. It is allowed to skip a spinlock. | If no linked list is specified, spinlocks cannot be nested.
